objective: Integrate existing collectors, cached JDs, eligibility and current scoring with distinct UI states and bounded zero-cost analysis for uncertain eligibility.
allowed_changes: Preserve existing structured work mode and country metadata from collectors and use conservative eligibility checks without guessing unknowns
Distinguish absent JD, pending, failure, scored and eligibility-unconfirmed states; hide CV generation for invalid JD
Score valid cached JDs locally at zero API cost when eligibility is unconfirmed
Queue only confirmed eligible candidates for existing paid AI evaluation with current budget and persisted scores
Start bounded confirmed eligible scoring during discovery, retaining deduplication and global candidate selection
Reuse existing JD cache, scorer, CV engine and collectors; test before/after, cost, filters, UI and performance
forbidden_changes: scoring formula, profile facts, CV generation engine or templates
new services, dependencies, database tables, schedulers or collectors
paid AI calls for unconfirmed eligibility or invalid JD
assuming missing country or work mode implies eligibility
main or production changes, GitHub Actions, Vercel or mock substitutions
acceptance: Unconfirmed vacancies stay unconfirmed; valid JD allows zero-cost local scoring
Missing or invalid JD never triggers scoring or CV button
Only confirmed eligible vacancies with valid JD enter paid AI scoring; caching prevents duplicate charges
First confirmed candidates score before full catalog scan while total work remains bounded
Twenty real sampled search-matching jobs and cached JDs verify coverage, time, quality and no regressions
Scope gate and relevant tests pass; canary UI verified before release; main untouched
deployment: Canary only; no main merge without explicit user approval
